Build a technology object from a techspec

Source: R/techspec.R
tech_from_spec.Rd

Reads, validates, and constructs the newTechnology() call described by the spec. Errors in the issue report stop the build (warnings are shown).

Usage

tech_from_spec(spec, strict = FALSE)

Arguments

spec

Path or list (see read_techspec()).

strict

Stop on warnings too? Default FALSE.

Value

A technology object.

Examples

f <- system.file("techspec", "examples", "coal_power.yml",
                 package = "energyRt")
if (nzchar(f)) tech_from_spec(f)
